The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”

parallels.note: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”

translations.web: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”
translations.bsb: The devil said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.”
translations.kjv: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.
translations.asv: And the devil said unto him, if thou art the Son of God, command this stone that it become bread.
